Living in the Software Age.summary: Software has quietly become the layer on which civilization runs. Most of us live inside it without noticing — the question is what it means to build it well.

Extending Human Intelligence.summary: The computer was never supposed to replace thinking. It was supposed to be a bicycle for the mind. We are only now learning to ride.

The Future of Text.summary: Text is the oldest compression algorithm for thought. What happens to writing when machines can write back?

Innovation is a Mindset.summary: Innovation is not a department or a grant. It is a posture toward problems: the refusal to accept that the current way is the only way.

Produce a Lot of Shitty Work.summary: Volume beats perfection. The path to good work runs directly through a mountain of bad work, produced without shame.

On Being a Founder.summary: Nobody tells you that founding is less about ideas and more about endurance. The company becomes a mirror you cannot look away from.

What are the Mathnuscripts.summary: A living system of mind: memory, meaning and making reinforcing one another until ideas become persons that act in the world.

Publishing My Second Brain.summary: A garden is published unfinished on purpose. The open kitchen, not the canon — where readers watch thought being cooked.

The Appeal of Personal Blogs.summary: In an age of feeds, a personal blog is a room of one's own on the internet. Slow, owned, and answerable only to its gardener.

Knowledge, Innovation and Africa.summary: The strength of a civilisation is shaped by its ability to create and preserve knowledge. Africa's next liberation is a knowledge liberation.

The Future is African.summary: The youngest continent, the oldest land. The future will not be handed to us — it will be built here, by people who believe it can be.

In Search of Competence.summary: Competence is the quiet self-respect of doing hard things well. It cannot be borrowed, bought, or performed — only earned, slowly.

Choosing your Game will Choose Your Life.summary: Pick the game carefully. The scoreboard you accept becomes the life you live, and most people never notice they are playing someone else's.

Towards Being a Man.summary: Becoming a man is not an event but a never-ending process — a calculus with no final answer, only better approximations.

Avocado ROI Calculator (Kenya).summary: A working field instrument: model the real cost and return of an avocado shamba in Kenya, season by season.
